description: This file defines the 'ExplorePage' React component, which is a page for exploring travel destinations with search, destination grid, and trip planning sidebar functionalities.

methods.name: inPlan
methods.description: Checks if a destination is already included in the current trip plan.

methods.name: addToPlan
methods.description: Adds a destination to the trip plan if it is not already included.

methods.name: removeFromPlan
methods.description: Removes a destination from the trip plan.
